Describe is the second WHAT skill. Use clear words for what you directly notice, separating observations from interpretations.

## Describe {#describe}

Name sensations, emotions, thoughts, and events in simple language. When an interpretation appears, label it as a thought rather than a fact.
## Source / Printable Copy

[Describe source page](/resources/mindfulness/mindfulness-describe-source.pdf)

## Text Version / Adapted Text

Describe by putting words on what you directly notice. Separate an observable fact (“my shoulders tightened”) from an interpretation (“this will be a disaster”). Use simple language for thoughts, feelings, sensations, and urges without insisting that the label is the whole experience.

[Emotion Explorer](/tool-finder/emotions/) can support observing and describing emotions.
